name: When to plant
description: A UK planting calendar for what to sow, plant out and harvest each month, written for British gardens rather than US seasons.
lede: A month-by-month calendar for British gardens: what to sow under cover, what can go outside, and what you can harvest. Dates follow RHS and Gardeners' World guidance, not American frost charts.
timingNote: These months suit a typical UK season. Gardens in the north, on high ground and in frost pockets run later. Mild coastal spots and city centres often run earlier.
